password_setting.label: Admin API Key
password_setting.help: An OpenAI Admin API key (starts with sk-admin-). Only organization owners can create one: in the OpenAI Platform go to Settings > Organization > Admin keys. Admin keys can read organization usage and costs but cannot call model endpoints, so they cannot run LLM evaluations.

additional_config_fields.label: Tags
additional_config_fields.help: Comma-separated tags added to the usage metrics collected with this key (not to cost data), for example team:ai,env:prod.

toggle.label: Collect cost data to view in Cloud Cost Management
toggle.help: You must be subscribed to Cloud Cost Management to use this data.
